blind.description: A medieval great helm (crusader helmet) with a flat top and slightly tapering cylindrical shape. It features brass or bronze reinforcement cross-straps and rim bands studded with rivets, along with narrow horizontal eye slits and small breathing perforations on the faceplate. The surface is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in dark blackened steel with metallic brass fittings. It stands upright on its lower rim directly on the ground with no plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A flat circular dark grey top surrounded by a thin golden rim, with a slight protrusion of the visor band at the front, casting an elongated shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 to 1/5 the height of the figure (roughly 14 to 16 inches tall) and about 10 to 12 inches in diameter.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
